meta.title: Lease Loop
meta.description: Lease an e-bike, laptop or farm machine. When the lease ends, it gets a second life.
brand.name: Lease Loop
brand.tagline: Circular leasing for e-bikes, laptops and farm machines
catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.intro: Every item can be leased, returned, refurbished and leased again.
catalogue.empty: No assets in the database yet. Run npm run db:setup and reload.

catalogue.reasonReturned: Returned. Back soon, as a second-life item.
catalogue.reasonTooCheap: Too cheap to lease. The minimum is {amount} excl. VAT.
catalogue.reasonNeedsDown: Needs a down payment of at least {amount} to fit the leasing limit.

quote.title: Your monthly price
quote.listPrice: List price today {price} excl. VAT · price list {version}
quote.bandHint.crosses: Good to know: from {amount} down, the amount we finance drops into band {band}, which has {rate} % yearly interest instead of {currentRate} %.
quote.bandHint.moved: Your down payment moves the amount we finance into band {band}: {rate} % yearly interest instead of {originalRate} %. Up to {amount} down keeps band {originalBand}.
quote.lockNote: Signing locks the rent without VAT. VAT is set by law, so each invoice uses the rate valid on its date.
quote.notLeasable.reserved: This item is reserved for another customer.
quote.notLeasable.returned: This item is back from a lease and is being inspected. It will get a new price soon.
quote.noPrice: There is no price for this item today.
quote.refusal.below_minimum: We can't lease this: the amount to finance is below our minimum of 300 €. Try a smaller down payment.
quote.refusal.above_maximum: The amount to finance is above our maximum of 250 000 €.
quote.refusal.down_payment_not_below_pri: The down payment must be less than the price.
quote.refusal.down_payment_negative: The down payment can't be negative.
quote.refusal.unknown_term: We offer leases of 12, 24, 36 or 48 months.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.empty: No contracts yet. Sign a lease, or run the demo seed script.
contract.subtitle: {assets} · {term}-month lease
contract.title: Contract {number}
contract.secondLifePrice: Price for life {life}: market value after refurbishment
contract.lockReason.same_day: Quoted and signed on the same day, {signedOn}: that day's price, {signing}, is locked.
contract.lockReason.quote_price_honoured: The price went up after your quote on {quotedOn}, so we kept the quoted price {quoted} instead of {signing} on {signedOn}. You save {difference}.
contract.lockReason.price_dropped_since_: The price dropped after your quote on {quotedOn}: you got the lower price on the signing day {signedOn}, {signing} instead of {quoted}. You save {difference}.
contract.lockReason.quote_expired: Your quote from {quotedOn} was older than 14 days, so the price on the signing day {signedOn} applies: {signing} (quoted {quoted}, difference {difference}).
timeTravel.title: Time travel
timeTravel.intro: Replay the contract month by month.
timeTravel.vatExplain: Your rent is still locked at {net}. The law raised VAT from {from} % to {to} %. The invoice due on {since} is the first one at the new rate, so each invoice changed by {difference}. VAT is set by law, not by us.
timeTravel.monthEnd: Your lease started on day {day}. In shorter months the invoice is due on the last day of the month, including 29 February in leap years.
timeTravel.addsUpNo: No: the invoices do not match the contract
invoice.caption: All invoices of this contract
earlyExit.title: Leave after month {month}?
earlyExit.rule: Our rule: you pay what the lease still owes today, the rents left and the buyout, without the interest for months that won't happen. Leaving early never costs more than staying.
earlyExit.keepDetail: {net} without VAT: {rents} rents left and the buyout ({undiscounted}), minus {saved} of interest you no longer owe.
earlyExit.returnDetail: You still owe {owed} without VAT. The item goes back to us, so we deduct its market value today, {value}. You pay the difference, {net} without VAT. If it is worth more than you owe, you pay nothing.
sign.title: Sign your lease
sign.notApproved: This application is not approved, so it can't be signed. A person will contact you if it is under review.
sign.signatoryOnly: The applicant can't sign for the company. The authorised signatory signs here.
sign.waitingFor: This contract waits for the company's authorised signatory, {email}. The applicant can't sign it.
sign.name: Full name of the person signing
sign.accept: I have read the terms above and accept them. The rent without VAT is locked from now on.
sign.simulated: Demo: a simulated e-signature. A real contract would be signed with strong identification such as bank ID.
sign.reason.ASSET_NOT_AVAILABLE: This item is no longer available, so this lease can’t be signed. Please apply for another item.
sign.reason.ASSET_NOT_FOUND: We could not find an item in this application. Please apply again.
sign.reason.APPLICATION_ALREADY_SIGNED: This lease has already been signed. You find it under Contracts.
sign.reason.APPLICATION_NOT_APPROVED: This application is not approved, so it can’t be signed.
sign.reason.APPLICATION_NOT_FOUND: We could not find this application. Please check the link or apply again.
sign.reason.NO_PRICE_ON_DATE: There is no price for this item today, so the lease can’t be signed. Please try again later.
sign.reason.NETWORK: We could not reach our service. Check your connection and try again.
sign.reason.generic: This lease can’t be signed right now. Please try again later, or contact us.
apply.title: Apply for a lease
apply.intro: Three short steps. We only ask what we need, and we tell you why.
apply.empty: There is nothing to apply for yet. Run npm run db:setup and reload.
apply.deal.title: What do you want to lease?
apply.field.customerHelp: Demo people. Pick one and the answers below fill in by themselves. You can change them.
apply.notAvailable: This item is "{status}" and cannot be leased right now. Please pick another.
apply.field.downHelp: Paid at the start. A bigger down payment means a smaller monthly rent. Leave empty for none.
apply.downTooHigh: The most you can pay down on this lease is {max}: half the price, and at least 300 € left to finance.
apply.moneyBad: Please type an amount like 2500 or 2500,50.
apply.summary: Total price excl. VAT: {price}. Amount we finance: {financed}.
apply.you.title: About you
apply.you.intro: Only the questions that matter for your choice are shown. If you change something above, this list may change.
apply.why.q_full_name: The contract is made in your name.
apply.why.q_birth_date: You must be 18 or older to sign a lease.
apply.why.q_email: Invoices and the contract are sent here.
apply.why.q_country: We can lease only to residents of Finland, Sweden and Estonia.
apply.why.q_employment: Helps us check the rent fits your budget.
apply.why.q_monthly_income: Rent may be at most 30 % of net income for consumers.
apply.why.q_business_id: Identifies the business that signs the contract.
apply.why.q_company_name: Printed on the contract and invoices.
apply.why.q_can_sign: Only an authorised signatory can make the contract binding.
apply.why.q_signatory_email: We send the contract to them for signing.
apply.why.q_vat_registered: Changes how we show prices: with or without VAT.
apply.why.q_usage_purpose: Delivery use wears the bike faster and changes the end-of-term check.
apply.why.q_farm_registry: Farm machines are leased to registered farms or contractors.
apply.why.q_annual_revenue: Required for leases of 50,000 EUR or more.
apply.why.q_beneficial_owners: Anti-money-laundering law requires us to know who owns the business.
apply.why.q_pep: Required by anti-money-laundering law for leases of 10,000 EUR or more.
apply.why.q_pep_details: A politically exposed person needs a manual check by a person, not a rule.
apply.fromRecord: Taken from your customer record. It cannot be changed here.
apply.cleared: Because of your change we no longer need these answers, so we removed them: {list}.
apply.send.title: Send it
apply.send.intro: We check your application right away and show the result on this page.
apply.errors.fix: Some fields need a look. They are marked above.
apply.error.generic: We could not send your application. Nothing was lost. Please try again in a moment.
apply.error.ASSET_NOT_AVAILABLE: This item is not available right now. Please pick another one.
apply.error.ASSET_NOT_FOUND: We could not find this item. Please pick another one.
apply.error.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some answers are not in a form we can read. Please check them and try again.
apply.error.MISSING_ANSWERS: Some questions are still unanswered. Please check the form and try again.
apply.error.MIXED_CATEGORIES: One application can only cover one kind of item. Please apply for the other kinds separately.
apply.error.PRICE_NOT_AVAILABLE: We have no price for this item today. Please pick another one or try again later.
apply.error.UNKNOWN_CUSTOMER: We could not find this customer. Please pick someone from the list.
apply.result.approved.title: Good news: approved
apply.result.approved.body: Your application passed every check. The contract to sign is the next step.
apply.result.rejected.title: We cannot approve this right now
apply.result.rejected.body: This is not a verdict on you. Here is the reason, in plain words.
apply.result.pending.title: Almost there: another person must sign
apply.result.pending.body: Your application is fine so far. We are waiting for someone who is allowed to sign.
apply.result.manual_review.title: A person will check your application
apply.result.manual_review.body: We have not said no. For this kind of case a person always takes a look before we decide.
apply.result.adultOn: You turn 18 on {date}. Come back then and we will gladly help you.
apply.result.signatory: We will contact {email} about the signing.
apply.result.signatoryLink: Open the contract for the signatory
apply.reason.MIN_AGE: You need to be 18 or older to sign a lease.
apply.reason.RESIDENCY: We can lease only to people who live in Finland, Sweden or Estonia.
apply.reason.AFFORDABILITY_EXCEEDED: The monthly rent incl. VAT is more than 30 % of your monthly net income. A cheaper item, a longer term or a bigger down payment may help.
apply.reason.AFFORDABILITY_NOT_ASSESSED: No monthly income was given, so we did not compare the rent with it.
apply.reason.BUSINESS_ID_INVALID: The business ID is not valid. Please check it for typing mistakes.
apply.reason.PEP_MANUAL_REVIEW: People in important public roles are always checked by a person. This is a rule for everyone, not a doubt about you.
apply.reason.FINANCED_OUT_OF_RANGE: The amount we would finance must be between 300 and 250,000 euro. Try a different item, number or down payment.
apply.reason.SIGNATORY_REQUIRED: The person applying cannot sign for the company. Someone who is allowed to sign for the company must sign the contract.
apply.reason.UNKNOWN: Another rule applied. Please contact us and we will explain.
secondLife.subtitle: Returned in {condition} condition with {usage}. Previous leases: {lives}.
secondLife.notReturned: This item is not back with us, so there is no next life to plan yet.
secondLife.nobody: Nobody on the waiting list fits this item right now. It stays in stock until someone does.
secondLife.leaseAgainHelp: Signs a {term}-month lease at {rent} a month excl. VAT, today. The work above is done first, so the item goes out in {condition} condition.
secondLife.leaseAgainError: We could not sign this lease. Reload the page and try again.
secondLife.rent: {amount} a month excl. VAT, for {term} months
secondLife.why.stricter_condition: {other} needs it by the same day but also accepts a {condition} item, so they will have more items to choose from. {who} needs a better one.
secondLife.why.signed_up_first: {other} has exactly the same needs. {who} signed up first.
secondLife.why.only: Nobody else on the waiting list fits this item.
secondLife.refurbYes: Yes: {total} of work before the next lease.
secondLife.upgradePays: The repair adds {gain} of value for {cost} of work, so it pays for itself.
secondLife.priceFormula: List price today {list} × {curve} % for {age} months of age × {multiplier} for {condition} condition × {usage} % for wear
secondLife.priceNote: The price is what the item is worth on the market after the work, so the next person pays for what they get. Age counts from 1 January of the model year.
secondLife.waitNote: Order when several fit: who needs it soonest, then who has fewer other options (a stricter condition), then who signed up first.
secondLife.who.wait-03: Commuter, wants it to look new
secondLife.who.wait-04: Small bakery, cargo bike for deliveries
secondLife.who.wait-13: Delivery courier, same budget as wait-02
secondLife.who.wait-14: Same needs as wait-06, signed up one day later
secondLife.result.eligible: Fits, but is later in line
secondLife.result.no_upgrade_path: We cannot bring it to that condition
secondLife.result.upgrade_not_worth_it: The repair would cost more than it adds
secondLife.result.over_budget: The rent is over their budget
secondLife.result.unknown_term: We do not offer that term
secondLife.co2.data_hint: estimate from the data hint, no record of its condition then
secondLife.co2.wear_adjusted: only the life it has left counts
secondLife.co2WithNext: CO₂ saved with its next life
secondLife.co2Method: Fictional factors. A reused item avoids making a new one, but only for the share of life it has left: its market value against today’s list price, minus the CO₂ of the refurbishment.
endOfTerm.title: End of term
endOfTerm.intro: The lease ends on {date}. Then you choose what happens to the item.
endOfTerm.choice: What do you want to do?
endOfTerm.buyHint: The buyout locked when you signed, {net} excl. VAT, with VAT at the rate on {date}.
endOfTerm.returnHint: We check it, refurbish it and lease it to someone else.
endOfTerm.pass_onHint: It goes straight to the next person on our waiting list.
endOfTerm.usageMin: At least {value}: usage cannot go down.
endOfTerm.demo: Demo: there is no real clock here, so confirming jumps to the end of the term.
endOfTerm.failed: That did not work ({code}). Nothing was changed.
endOfTerm.ended.bought: Bought on {date}. The item is yours.
endOfTerm.ended.returned: Returned on {date}. Thank you: it now gets another life.
endOfTerm.ended.passed_on: Passed on on {date}. It goes straight to the next person waiting.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every change to the data, newest first (the last {limit}). Each row is written together with the change itself, so nothing changes without a trace.
audit.action.contract.bought: Item bought at the end of term
audit.action.contract.returned: Item returned at the end of term
audit.action.contract.passed_on: Item passed on at the end of term

explain.vat_change.hint: From {date} VAT is {rate} %, so the last {count} invoices are {gross} each. The total below includes it.
explain.total_cost.hintVatChange: Down payment + all monthly payments, each with the VAT of its due date
explain.buyout.hintVatChange: {percent} % of the amount we finance, {gross} with VAT ({rate} %, the rate on the day it is due)
secondLife.result.already_served: Already got an item from us
